Container.Name: OneDrive-Archiver
Container.Overview: OneDrive Archiver signs in to Microsoft OneDrive, lets you browse your drive, and archives selected files or folders to an Unraid share.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Container port for the OneDrive Archiver web interface. Change the host port if 3000 is already in use.

Config.Name: Archive Download Path
Config.Description: Unraid path where server-side OneDrive archive files will be written.

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Run the app in production mode.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Public URL used for OAuth callbacks. Use HTTPS for non-localhost installs and add APP_URL/api/callback in Azure.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random string used to sign the local auth session cookie.

Config.Name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Azure app registration client secret value, not the secret ID.

Config.Name: SERVER_DOWNLOAD_ROOT
Config.Description: Container path that server-side downloads are constrained to. This should match the container path above.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used to write files. Unraid default is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used to write files. Unraid users group default is 100.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone, for example America/New_York or Europe/Bucharest.
